QuestInfo.name: [Neo Tokyo] Into the Twisted Birdcage
QuestInfo.0: To save humanity from the war, Asia asks that you time travel to Zipangu's year 2100 -- through the use of Kamuna's blue crystal -- and recover the stolen #t4032151#, the key to humanity's ultimate weapon.
QuestInfo.1: The #t4032151# is in the hands of the machines' Crosswall Armored Division. Before you can take it back from the #o9601810# convoy, you'll need to reduce the number of #o9601813#s circling in the sky.
QuestInfo.2: You cleared the #o9601813#s from the sky. Now you have a shot at reclaiming the #t4032151#.
